name: map filter zip battery
code:
print(list(map(lambda x: x * x, [1, 2, 3, 4])))
print(list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, range(10))))
print(list(zip([1, 2, 3], 'abc', [True, False, True])))
print(list(map(lambda a, b: a + b, [1, 2], [10, 20])))

name: closure counter
code:
def make_counter():
    n = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return inc
c1 = make_counter()
c2 = make_counter()
print(c1(), c1(), c2(), c1())
